title: An etale algebra over a normal ring is a normal ring
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. If $A$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], then $B$ is a normal ring.

source.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemma Tag 033C (lemma-normal-goes-up: R -> S smooth, R normal => S normal), applied to an etale ring map, which is standard smooth (Lemma Tag 00U9, lemma-etale-standard-smooth) hence smooth; Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GJ (2) for Spec B -> Spec A etale => A -> B etale. Used in More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 06DI.

proof.text: *$\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is smooth.* By hypothesis $f=\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-smooth-zero-dimensional-fibres] an etale morphism of schemes is smooth in the sense of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] (locally of finite presentation and formally smooth); so $f$ is smooth.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 06DI (lemma-henselization-normal, line 11110): 'filtered colimits of etale hence smooth R-algebras, the result follows from Algebra, Lemma normal-goes-up' (Tag 033C)

proof.text: *$A\to B$ is a smooth ring map.* The morphism $f$ is $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the ring map $A\to B$. By [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-iff-smooth-affine], $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is smooth in the sense of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] if and only if $A\to B$ is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]; by the first step the left side holds, so $A\to B$ is smooth.

proof.text: *$B$ is normal.* $A$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] and $A\to B$ is a smooth ring map by the second step, so $B$ is a normal ring by [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-over-normal-ring-normal] (Stacks 033C, normality goes up along smooth ring maps).
